findings.reader: A well-bounded dated news explainer: it puts the safety answer first as the format permits, walks the full consent chain from lure to Accessibility grant, defines each term in context, keeps Google guidance within scope, and lands on precise limits instead of alarm. Explain-back and a novel QR-code transfer scenario both resolve correctly from the article's mechanism; no defect families are present.
